name: WPF Settings Dialog Shell
description: Two-pane desktop settings dialog with left category navigation, Save/Cancel actions, Escape cancellation, and JSON-friendly settings state.

preview.caption: Native Windows WPF dialog — inspect XAML and C# source tabs for clean modal dialog composition.
architecture: Dialog Action Footer (IsDefault Save + IsCancel Cancel)
preview.projectRef: Drop into any <UseWPF>true</UseWPF> .NET Desktop project under Views/SettingsDialog/

install: Copy SettingsDialog.xaml and SettingsDialog.xaml.cs into your WPF project under Views/.
usage: Open modally via var dlg = new SettingsDialog(currentSettings) { Owner = this }; if (dlg.ShowDialog() == true) Save(dlg.Settings);

verification.label: WPF Compile & XAML Checked
verification.details: XAML namespaces, tags, and Click handler bindings validated cross-platform and compiled natively with <UseWPF>true</UseWPF> in Windows CI. Interactive desktop dialog rendering requires a Windows WPF host.
